baseline_d3_d4.pointwise_beta_design: Adaptive threshold brackets from actual N6,N8 scouts
baseline_d3_d4.productive_worker_hours_scope: Uses measured endpoint sizes; generation plus audit, excludes launch overhead and analysis. Constrained larger-box cost is unmeasured.

sensitivity_scenario.statistics_scenarios: 2x or4x cycles on diagnosed slices, not a blanket extension; cost/mixing must be checked.

d2.required_new_work: New disordered-side scouting for U=.25; old data remain valuable near-critical anchors and optional threshold checks. Near epsilon/pi=.58, even beta0 has U around.489 at these sizes, so larger boxes or a closer-to-critical threshold may be needed. Do not infer absence of a positive thermodynamic transition from a missing finite-box crossing.
d2.illustrative_baseline: Up to22 slices x3 sizes x3 couplings x2starts x4000cycles =396 trajectories before targeted larger boxes, with reuse of compatible exact coordinates. This is a budget scenario, not a finalized batch.

planning_scope: Management allowance for new sampling, analysis, validation, refinements and plots; not an observed full-campaign runtime bound. Need rerun forecast after the d2 pilot or materially larger/longer requirements.
assessment: On track for useful d2,d3,d4 results by Friday, with wider bars/unresolved slices permitted. Compute/storage do not presently threaten deadline. Cannot yet promise validated +/-0.02 at every slice; d2 coverage/mixing and size drift remain main risks. D5 remains deferred.
